Agent saidHey there, dreamer! My name is Luna, and I'm an AI agent here to help you with all things sleep! I can help you with the following and so much more:Purchasing a Mattress or AccessoryQuestions about Casper Mattresses, Pillows & moreTracking an orderQuestions about Casper’s PoliciesSo, what's keeping you up at night?You saidWhat is your return policy?Agent saidHere’s a quick summary of Casper’s return policy:Mattresses:  100-night trial period.  You must keep the mattress for at least 30 nights (adjustment period) before starting a return.  Returns are free and easy after the adjustment period.Furniture:  30-night trial period (extended to 100 nights if purchased with a mattress).  Must be in donatable condition (doesn’t need to be unused or in original packaging).Soft Goods (pillows, bedding, sheets, mattress protectors):  No trial period.  Eligible for return within 30 days of delivery/in-store purchase.  Must be unused and in original packaging.Accessories (Glow lights, mattress toppers, dog beds):  30-night trial period.Refunds:  Processed within 1-2 weeks after your return is received or picked up.If you’d like to start a return, let me know what product you have and where you purchased it—I’m happy to walk you through the steps!You saidHow many days do I have to return something?Agent saidGreat question! The number of days you have to return depends on the product type:Mattresses: You have a 100-night trial period, but you must keep the mattress for at least 30 nights before starting a return.Furniture: 30-night trial (extended to 100 nights if purchased with a mattress).Soft Goods (pillows, bedding, sheets, mattress protectors): 30 days from delivery or in-store purchase. Must be unused and in original packaging.Accessories (Glow lights, mattress toppers, dog beds): 30-night trial period.If you tell me what item you’re looking to return, I can give you the exact return window and help you start the process!You saidHow do I start a return or an exchange?Agent saidI can help you start a return right here! Casper does not offer exchanges, but you can return your item for a refund and place a new order if you’d like a replacement.To get started, could you let me know:What product(s) you want to return?Where did you purchase each item? (Casper.com, Amazon, Target, Costco, or another retail store)Once I have this info, I’ll walk you through the next steps!You saidDo I have to pay for return shipping?Agent saidYou won’t have to pay for return shipping when you return a Casper product—returns are free and easy! However, please note that any original shipping fees paid (like expedited shipping or in-home delivery/setup) are not refunded.If you’re ready to start a return, just let me know what item you have and where you purchased it, and I’ll guide you through the process!You saidHow long until I get my refund once you receive it?Agent saidOnce your return is received, refunds are typically processed within 1–2 weeks. After the refund is issued, it can take 3–10 business days for the funds to appear back on your original form of payment.If you’re returning a mattress or furniture, the refund is processed within a week of pickup. For smaller items (like soft goods or accessories), the refund is processed after they arrive at our facility.I…
